tables.name: policy_master
tables.definition:
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.policy_status)) AS policy_status,
  p.customer_id,
  p.product_code,
  p.effective_date,
  p.expiry_date
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p
WHERE p.policy_id IS NOT NULL

tables.name: policy_term
tables.definition:
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.policy_id ORDER BY p.effective_date) AS term_number,
  CASE
    WHEN p.policy_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RENEWED') THEN 'IN_FORCE'
    ELSE p.policy_status
  END AS term_status,
  p.effective_date AS term_start,
  p.expiry_date AS term_end
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p

tables.name: policy_status_daily
tables.definition:
SELECT
  CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date,
  m.policy_id,
  m.policy_status
FROM insurance.policy.policy_master AS m

tables.name: policy_status_history
tables.definition:
SELECT
  m.policy_id,
  LAG(m.policy_status) OVER (PARTITION BY m.policy_id ORDER BY m.effective_date) AS status_from,
  m.policy_status AS status_to,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS changed_at
FROM insurance.policy.policy_master AS m

tables.name: policy_lapse_summary
tables.definition:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', h.changed_at) AS month,
  COUNT_IF(h.status_to = 'LAPSED') AS lapsed_count,
  COUNT_IF(h.status_to = 'LAPSED') / COUNT(*) AS lapse_rate
FROM insurance.policy.policy_status_history AS h
GROUP BY 1

tables.name: renewal_eligibility
tables.definition:
SELECT
  t.policy_id,
  CASE
    WHEN m.policy_status <> 'ACTIVE' THEN FALSE
    WHEN t.term_status <> 'IN_FORCE' THEN FALSE
    WHEN DATEDIFF(t.term_end, CURRENT_DATE()) > 90 THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
  END AS is_eligible,
  CASE
    WHEN t.term_status <> 'IN_FORCE' THEN 'Term not in force'
  END AS eligibility_reason,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS evaluated_at
FROM insurance.policy.policy_term AS t
JOIN insurance.policy.policy_master AS m
  ON t.policy_id = m.policy_id

tables.name: renewal_candidates
tables.definition:
SELECT
  e.policy_id,
  t.term_end AS renewal_due_date,
  e.is_eligible
FROM insurance.policy.renewal_eligibility AS e
JOIN insurance.policy.policy_term AS t
  ON e.policy_id = t.policy_id
WHERE e.is_eligible

tables.name: policy_retention_metrics
tables.definition:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', c.renewal_due_date) AS month,
  COUNT_IF(c.is_eligible) AS retained_count,
  AVG(CASE WHEN h.status_to = 'RENEWED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retention_rate
FROM insurance.policy.renewal_candidates AS c
LEFT JOIN insurance.policy.policy_status_history AS h
  ON c.policy_id = h.policy_id
GROUP BY 1

views.name: vw_active_policies
views.sql:
SELECT
  policy_id,
  policy_status,
  premium_amount
FROM insurance.policy.policies
WHERE
  policy_status = 'ACTIVE'

views.name: vw_policy_summary
views.sql:
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  p.policy_status,
  COUNT(c.claim_id) AS claim_count
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p
LEFT JOIN insurance.policy.claims AS c
  ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id
GROUP BY
  p.policy_id,
  p.policy_status

views.name: vw_claims_by_policy
views.sql:
SELECT
  c.claim_id,
  c.policy_id,
  c.claim_amount
FROM insurance.policy.claims AS c

views.name: vw_open_claims
views.sql:
SELECT
  c.claim_id,
  c.policy_id,
  c.claim_amount,
  c.claim_status,
  c.claim_date
FROM insurance.policy.claims AS c
WHERE
  c.claim_status IN ('OPEN', 'PENDING')

views.name: vw_policy_revenue
views.sql:
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  p.premium_amount,
  SUM(pay.payment_amount) AS collected
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p
LEFT JOIN insurance.policy.payments AS pay
  ON p.policy_id = pay.policy_id
GROUP BY
  p.policy_id,
  p.premium_amount

views.name: vw_agent_performance
views.sql:
SELECT
  a.agent_id,
  a.agent_name,
  a.region,
  SUM(p.premium_amount) AS written_premium
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p
JOIN insurance.policy.agents AS a
  ON p.agent_id = a.agent_id
GROUP BY
  a.agent_id,
  a.agent_name,
  a.region

views.name: vw_product_mix
views.sql:
SELECT
  pr.line_of_business,
  pr.product_name,
  COUNT(p.policy_id) AS policy_count
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p
JOIN insurance.policy.products AS pr
  ON p.product_code = pr.product_code
GROUP BY
  pr.line_of_business,
  pr.product_name

views.name: vw_claims_ratio
views.sql:
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  p.premium_amount,
  SUM(c.claim_amount) AS incurred
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p
LEFT JOIN insurance.policy.claims AS c
  ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id
GROUP BY
  p.policy_id,
  p.premium_amount

views.name: vw_payment_health
views.sql:
SELECT
  pay.payment_status,
  pay.payment_method,
  COUNT(pay.payment_id) AS payments,
  SUM(pay.payment_amount) AS amount
FROM insurance.policy.payments AS pay
GROUP BY
  pay.payment_status,
  pay.payment_method

queries.sql:
SELECT
  policy_status,
  COUNT(*) AS policy_count
FROM insurance.policy.policies
GROUP BY
  policy_status

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', effective_date) AS month,
  SUM(premium_amount) AS total_premium
FROM insurance.policy.policies
GROUP BY
  1

SELECT
  c.loss_type,
  COUNT(c.claim_id) AS claims,
  SUM(c.claim_amount) AS amount
FROM insurance.policy.claims AS c
GROUP BY
  c.loss_type

SELECT
  a.agent_name,
  a.channel,
  SUM(p.premium_amount) AS premium
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p
JOIN insurance.policy.agents AS a
  ON p.agent_id = a.agent_id
GROUP BY
  a.agent_name,
  a.channel

SELECT
  pay.payment_method,
  COUNT(pay.payment_id) AS payments
FROM insurance.policy.payments AS pay
GROUP BY
  pay.payment_method

SELECT
  pr.product_name,
  SUM(p.premium_amount) AS premium
FROM insurance.policy.policies AS p
JOIN insurance.policy.products AS pr
  ON p.product_code = pr.product_code
GROUP BY
  pr.product_name
